escape: Any change to the install (characters, lorebooks, groups, the persona, the selected lorebooks) while the runner confirms no provisioning step, or any draft change that the accepted steps do not replay to. The runner accepts every draft edit and rejects every provisioning step, so the only legitimate draft is the replay of the accepted ops.
